name: Control Console Operating Manual
summary: At the Venture Company site southwest of Sludge Fen, workers turn to the Control Console Operating Manual to handle the machinery. It gives the valve sequence for disengaging the samophlange.

sections.title: Deciphering Goblin Machinery
sections.body: The Venture Company runs a drilling and research site in the northern Barrens, southwest of Sludge Fen. Gauges and pressurized valves connect to mechanisms that drive a device called a samophlange. Without the right instructions, the volatile controls can fail dangerously or lock the system. The manual shows workers how to disengage the core apparatus without causing an explosion.

faq.q: What is the Control Console Operating Manual used for?
aliases: why do i have operating manual
faq.answer: The Control Console Operating Manual guides you through the Venture Company console southwest of Sludge Fen. It shows how to close the valves and disengage the samophlange.
Researchers outside the Venture Company do not fully understand what a samophlange does. It appears to be a goblin-engineered core mechanism tied to drilling and industrial work in the Barrens.
Venture Company technicians overseeing the research outpost drafted the manual. It helps workers operate the console and keep pressure in its control valves at the intended levels.

faq.q: What happens if I lose the manual?
faq.answer: The console has gauges and readouts showing valve pressure. A skilled adventurer can read its face and operate the switches without the manual.

angles.text: The manual shows a goblin approach to engineering. Highly pressurized, marginally safe systems run through a chaotic array of levers and valves instead of balanced failsafes.
The manual gives Horde investigators a look inside the Venture Company's invasive industrial operations across the northern Barrens.
